prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic full-body street-fashion portrait of an approved adult woman at a European city intersection.
prompt.main_subject: An approved adult woman wearing a camouflage baseball cap, striped shirt, olive-green hoodie, beige wide-leg trousers, chunky black platform shoes, and carrying a black leather handbag. She stands casually beside a metal street pole.

prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural overcast daylight, cinematic street-photography mood, realistic fabric, leather, brick, pavement, and architectural texture.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic high-detail 35mm-style portrait, vertical full-body framing, shallow depth of field, natural color and accurate proportions.

Dress her in a camouflage baseball cap, striped shirt, olive-green hoodie, beige wide-leg trousers, chunky black platform shoes, and a black leather handbag.
